title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 245 ]

blocks.text: You are a member of your family, a player on the community baseball team, and a student in your school. You are also a citizen of your country. In short, you occupy several different positions in the complex structure of society. This means you should play many roles in different situations. Generally, you have little difficulty performing each of your roles because you know what is expected of you. This knowledge guides you through your daily interactions.

But sometimes you will get caught in a conflict. Each role of yours makes demands on you, and you may be asked to play two or more roles at the same time. When many roles make conflicting demands on you, you may feel quite uncomfortable and at times frustrated. For example, your family is going on a picnic this coming Sunday. But your best friend wants you to join his or her birthday party on the same day. When such role conflicts occur, you need to do more important things first. Thus, the ability to decide what to do in what order is an essential skill to fulfill multiple social roles

readingSentences.english: You are a member of your family, a player on the community baseball team, and a student in your school.

readingSentences.korean: 요컨대 당신은 복잡한 사회 구조 속에서 몇 가지 서로 다른 지위를 차지하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: This means you should play many roles in different situations.
readingSentences.korean: 이것은 당신이 다양한 상황에서 여러 가지 역할을 수행해야 함을 의미한다.

readingSentences.english: Generally, you have little difficulty performing each of your roles because you know what is expected of you.
readingSentences.korean: 일반적으로 당신은 자신에게 기대되는 바가 무엇인지 잘 알고 있기 때문에 각각의 역할을 수행하는 데 거의 어려움을 겪지 않는다.

readingSentences.english: This knowledge guides you through your daily interactions.
readingSentences.korean: 이러한 지식이 일상적인 사회적 상호작용 속에서 당신을 이끌어 준다.

readingSentences.english: But sometimes you will get caught in a conflict.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 때때로 당신은 어떤 역할 갈등에 휘말리게 될 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Each role of yours makes demands on you, and you may be asked to play two or more roles at the same time.
readingSentences.korean: 당신의 각각의 역할은 당신에게 요구를 하며, 당신은 동시에 둘 이상의 역할을 하도록 요청받을 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: When many roles make conflicting demands on you, you may feel quite uncomfortable and at times frustrated.
readingSentences.korean: 여러 역할이 서로 충돌하는 요구를 해올 때, 당신은 몹시 불편하고 때로는 좌절감을 느낄 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: For example, your family is going on a picnic this coming Sunday.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어 당신의 가족이 이번 다가오는 일요일에 소풍을 갈 예정이라고 하자.

readingSentences.english: But your best friend wants you to join his or her birthday party on the same day.
readingSentences.korean: 하지만 당신의 가장 친한 친구는 바로 같은 날 자신의 생일 파티에 와주기를 바란다.

readingSentences.english: When such role conflicts occur, you need to do more important things first.
readingSentences.korean: 그러한 역할 갈등이 발생할 때, 당신은 더 중요한 일을 먼저 해야 할 필요가 있다.

readingSentences.english: Thus, the ability to decide what to do in what order is an essential skill to fulfill multiple social roles
readingSentences.korean: 따라서 어떤 순서로 무엇을 해야 할지 현명하게 결정하는 능력이야말로 다중의 사회적 역할을 완수하기 위한 핵심적인 기술이다.
